description: This file defines the `FeedLogicBase` class, which serves as a base class for handling feed-related logic hooks within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM module. It includes methods to push feed data, and to install or remove hook functions tied to the module lifecycle.

classes.name: FeedLogicBase
classes.description: A base class providing common functionality for managing feed logic hooks in the CRM module.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to be overridden or used for pushing feed updates when a bean is saved.

methods.name: installHook
methods.description: Method to install a logic hook in the module, specifically for the 'before_save' event, linking it to the 'pushFeed' method.

methods.name: removeHook
methods.description: Method to remove the hook associated with the 'pushFeed' logic from the module's 'before_save' event.
